description: This file defines the CalculatedFieldDebugEvent class, a data model for debug events related to calculated fields within the Thingsboard platform. It includes fields for event details, methods for serialization to EventInfo, and annotations for boilerplate code generation.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldDebugEvent
classes.description: A class representing a debug event for calculated fields, extending the Event class, with fields for calculated field ID, event entity, message ID, message type, arguments, result, and error.

methods.name: CalculatedFieldDebugEvent
methods.description: Constructor annotated with @Builder to create instances with specified event details.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the event type, specifically EventType.DEBUG_CALCULATED_FIELD.

methods.name: toInfo
methods.description: Converts the event to an EventInfo object, including serializing relevant fields into JSON.
